_about: Test set for loosely worded requests and emergencies. Written for this check (not real 311 requests). 'accept' lists every complaint type a reasonable 311 operator could choose; 'advice:<id>' means no complaint type fits and the verified advice entry should be used instead. Cases marked lang are written in another language for this check.
